public_objects.receiving_job: Describe a source-neutral, replay-safe administrative adapter over repository-owned representative records.
Keep administrative state beside a release-scoped subject and episode.
Preserve a raw label beside open multi-label assignments or abstention.
Represent enrollment or synthetic eligibility without payer-decision effect.
Bind explicit policy inputs, precedence, missing-input behavior, conflicts, and digest.
Carry one reviewed administrative result, transition history, and recourse route.
Compare controlled clinical and administrative outputs at a declared evidence ceiling.
State scenario purpose, construction, dimensions, omissions, review, and claim boundary.
Record field- or relation-level formation in an acyclic dependency graph.

examples.purpose: Describe a modular administrative ETL route, representative insurance inputs, and a declared replay requirement without binding an external source.
Exercise independent multi-label classification, abstention, deterministic policy evaluation, and reviewed decisions.
Keep clinical evidence and output digests fixed while administrative digests differ.

compatibility.additive_rule: An optional field can remain in v1 only when producers negotiate support or carry it through a governed extension reference.
compatibility.changed_meaning_rule: A changed domain-term meaning receives a new term identity or vocabulary version.
compatibility.breaking_change_rule: A required-field, closed-state, digest-profile, field-meaning, or authority-invariant change advances the contract major version and supplies an adapter.

invalidation_triggers.condition: An adapter input contract, representative record, stage boundary, replay key, or output contract changes.
invalidation_triggers.response: Issue and review a new adapter contract version, then rerun its representative projections.

invalidation_triggers.condition: A vocabulary, prompt, model, code artifact, policy rule, precedence order, or review disposition changes.
invalidation_triggers.response: Issue a new independently versioned artifact or contract meaning and re-run affected examples.

invalidation_triggers.condition: A receiver seeks population, live-payer, clinical-validity, configured-deployment, or operational-acceptance claims.
invalidation_triggers.response: Route the claim to the named evidence and accountable review owner before adoption.

adoption_event.requirement: A reviewed Program merge accepts package version 0.4.0, these schema bytes, examples, and the resulting immutable package source coordinate.

adapter_contracts.name: Insurance and administrative fixture adapter
adapter_contracts.description: A source-neutral design for carrying raw insurance and enrollment inputs through explicit administrative transformation stages.

stages.operation: Read repository-owned representative records without changing their raw values.
Validate required record identity, version, raw label, and enrollment-state shapes.
Preserve raw labels beside normalized values and explicit missingness.
Produce multi-label, abstained, or unknown classifications with provenance.
Map raw-preserving classification and enrollment state into Program contract identities without producing a policy or accountable decision.
Emit canonical contract projections keyed by record identity and input version.

idempotency.replay_scope: One adapter version and one canonical representative-record payload.
idempotency.checkpoint_strategy: Commit a complete canonical projection only after every stage succeeds.
idempotency.retry_behavior: Retry the same replay key from the first stage and replace only with byte-identical canonical output.

required_enrichments.purpose: Bind each representative administrative value to a release-scoped subject and episode.
Supply the jurisdiction and effective interval used by the receiving context.
Resolve normalized labels into identified terms while preserving the raw input.
Attach formation evidence and any disposition required before a final classification or downstream decision.

adapter_contracts.claim_boundary: The representative records illustrate adapter contract mechanics. Configured execution and enrollment, eligibility, coverage, prevalence, payer behavior, clinical validity, deployment, and regulated-use claims follow their named evidence routes.

population_scenarios.title: Independently authored dual-label and pending-enrollment policy mechanics
omissions: No real payer policy, member record, patient data, or operational decision is represented.
The fixture is not calibrated to population prevalence, access disparity, or clinical outcomes.

review_participants.contribution: Confirmed that the administrative variation leaves the declared clinical evidence and output unchanged.
Reviewed the synthetic classification, policy, decision, and recourse boundaries.

small_cell_policy.rationale: This two-arm mechanism fixture makes no subgroup or population estimate.

population_scenarios.claim_boundary: The scenario demonstrates contract mechanics only; it supplies no population, payer, clinical, or deployment inference.

review.rationale: Accepted both open-vocabulary assignments while preserving the raw fixture label.
Accepted the single open-vocabulary assignment while preserving the raw fixture label.

insurance_classifications.ambiguity: The raw phrase does not establish a payer, program, plan, enrollment, or controlled classification.

review.rationale: Accepted abstention as the final classification disposition for this synthetic fixture.

insurance_classifications.ambiguity: The source fixture provides no raw insurance label or source evidence supporting a classification.

review.rationale: Accepted the explicit unknown state because the synthetic source carries no insurance label evidence.

rules.description: Route an accepted abstention to an evidence request.
Route the declared multi-label active fixture to manual review.
Route any accepted commercial term with active enrollment to synthetic standard processing when no higher-precedence rule governs.

reason_terms.label: Accountable review revised the engine proposal

recourse.instructions: Revise the synthetic input or rule set and issue a successor evaluation; no operational payer action exists.

review.rationale: Revised the deterministic manual-review proposal to request additional evidence within the synthetic fixture claim ceiling.

recourse.instructions: Supply a separately evidenced classification or retain abstention; no operational payer action exists.

review.rationale: Accepted the evidence-request result as synthetic policy behavior, not a payer determination.

recourse.instructions: Supply evidence for the required enrollment state and issue a successor evaluation; no operational payer action exists.

review.rationale: Accepted the explicit evidence-request fallback because the required enrollment state is absent.

impact_observations.interpretation: The fixture changes administrative classification and enrollment state while the declared clinical evidence and clinical output remain byte-identical; it supports a mechanism observation, not a causal or population claim.
